description: A supplied template whose kept parts hold active and external content (§10.4): the master's linked picture loses its link and keeps its hyperlink, a picture linked through a hyperlink relationship loses its link, and two hyperlinks §4.5 refuses (one behind a leading space, C59) and an action that runs a program go while their shapes stay; a layout loses its embedded OLE object with its alternate, preview and animation, its linked OLE object, its ActiveX control, its Office add-in and its legacy VML drawing (never parsed), so the embedded document, the control's parts, the add-in and the drawing aren't in the package; another layout, related to nothing but its master, loses an action that runs a macro; external relationships nothing refers to are dropped from the presentation (one with its target mode in lower case) and the theme. One `template_content_removed` per object, add-in, action or other removed relationship. With no font resolver, the template's fonts Brand Display and Source Serif 4 are `font_unresolved`; Brand Sans, which it embeds, isn't reported in pptx output (§3).
